title: Site 1000 Sonic Flow purchasing and production

places.name: SapReorderSignal
places.description: Externally supplied SAP inventory-position snapshot in Sonaflozin units, reportedly on-hand plus on-order; inclusion of quarantine and calculation timing unverified.

places.name: SonaflozinOrdered
places.description: Chinese Supplier Sonaflozin order carrying units and provisional remaining life starting at order; supplier-preparation start and future supplier shelf life need confirmation.

places.name: SonaflozinInTransit
places.description: Ordered Sonaflozin shipment in transit, possibly held at customs; no transit duration distribution assumed.

places.name: ShipmentArrivalNotice
places.description: Externally supplied arrival/clearance event: timing not yet specified, including customs holds.

places.name: SonaflozinQuarantine
places.description: Arrived Sonaflozin unavailable for production pending quality release.

places.name: QualityReleaseNotice
places.description: Externally supplied quality clearance for a quarantined shipment; elapsed quarantine time and rejection criteria unresolved.

places.name: SonaflozinReleased
places.description: Individual quality-released Sonaflozin lots carry units and remaining usable weeks; no aggregated stock token required.

places.name: ProductionOrderWaiting
places.description: Production orders each carrying the number of Sonic Flow units requested; arrival and scheduling of orders remain external.

places.name: FlowbindAvailable
places.description: Usable Flowbind lots with time remaining on each lot; 156 weeks remaining for current stock is the team's assumption at record observation, not a value for new receipts.

places.name: SonicFlowBatchProduced
places.description: Unshipped finished Sonic Flow batches, with units and age in weeks since the represented production completion; not cumulative production.

places.name: CustomerOrdersWaiting
places.description: Externally supplied contract or spot customer order, with units and weeks until due; due-date source and partial fulfillment unresolved.

places.name: SonicFlowShipped
places.description: Customer orders shipped by their due time; one token per order carries shipped units for provisional order-based fill reporting.

places.name: SonicFlowExpired
places.description: Cumulative stock reaching the approximate age cutoff before sale, not confirmed physical scrap.

places.name: IndianSupplierOutage
places.description: Externally supplied indication that Indian Supplier is out; no onset or recovery schedule established.

places.name: GermanFlowbindTopUpOrdered
places.description: New German emergency Flowbind lot pending receipt; supplier-start remaining life is unknown and uses an agent placeholder, not the team's current-stock assumption.

places.name: GermanFlowbindReceiptNotice
places.description: Externally supplied physical receipt of German emergency Flowbind into quarantine; quality release remains required before production use.

places.name: FlowbindStockReading
places.description: Externally supplied reading of total Flowbind stock in units; using a single lot as the <500 trigger would be incorrect.

places.name: SonaflozinExpiredUnits
places.description: Cumulative Sonaflozin units expiring AFTER Site 1000 receipt, including quarantine; excludes pre-receipt losses. Monetary disposal/write-down unknown.

places.name: FlowbindExpiredUnits
places.description: Cumulative Flowbind units expiring after Site 1000 receipt from opening stock, Indian regular or German emergency supply; pre-receipt losses excluded, disposal cost unknown.

places.name: ContractOrdersShippedLate
places.description: Contract orders shipped after due; one token per late order carries units, lateness payment not valued.

places.name: SpotOrdersCancelled
places.description: Spot customer orders cancelled while waiting; one token per lost-sale order carries requested units; price unknown.

places.name: SpotCustomerCancellationNotice
places.description: Externally supplied spot-customer cancellation event while an order waits; rate and timing not inferred.

places.name: PurchaseCostCommitted
places.description: Cumulative priced order-commitment events for Chinese Sonaflozin, Indian regular Flowbind and German emergency Flowbind; excludes storage, shortage, disposal, lateness and other costs.

places.name: GermanSwitchCostEvents
places.description: EUR 5,000 estimated team switching-charge events when placing an emergency German Flowbind order; not measured at Site 1000.

places.name: SonaflozinReceivedUnits
places.description: Cumulative units received into Site 1000 quarantine during period; opening stock supplied separately.

places.name: FlowbindReceivedUnits
places.description: Cumulative newly received Flowbind units at Site 1000 from modeled Indian regular and German emergency orders; opening stock separately required.

places.name: SonaflozinPreReceiptLossUnits
places.description: Sonaflozin units lost before Site 1000 receipt, outside site's expired-stock percentage; quality-rejection classification tentative.

places.name: FlowbindPreReceiptLossUnits
places.description: Indian or German Flowbind units lost before Site 1000 receipt, outside site's expired-stock percentage; quality classification and liability unsettled.

places.name: FlowbindSapPositionReading
places.description: Externally supplied Indian-flowbind SAP inventory-position snapshot in units; exact on-hand/on-order computation not internal.

places.name: IndianFlowbindOnOrder
places.description: Regular Flowbind order with units and ageing while supplier prepares/transports it; new-lot life agent placeholder, arrival externally supplied.

places.name: IndianFlowbindReceiptNotice
places.description: Externally supplied physical receipt of routine Indian Flowbind into quarantine; quality release is a separate requirement.

places.name: FlowbindQuarantine
places.description: Received Indian or German Flowbind lots age while waiting for Site 1000 quality release; cannot enter production before release.

places.name: FlowbindQualityReleaseNotice
places.description: External quality authorization to release one quarantined Flowbind lot; release delay and rejection criteria unresolved.

places.name: SonaflozinQualityRejectionNotice
places.description: Externally supplied quality-failure decision for one quarantined Sonaflozin lot; 5% team industry assumption not implemented as an automatic draw.

places.name: FlowbindQualityRejectionNotice
places.description: Externally supplied quality-failure decision for one quarantined Flowbind lot, either Indian or German.

places.name: SonaflozinRejectedUnits
places.description: Cumulative Sonaflozin units rejected by quality after Site receipt and sent for disposal; separate from age-expired units; monetary disposal unknown.

places.name: FlowbindRejectedUnits
places.description: Cumulative Indian or German Flowbind units rejected by quality after Site receipt and sent for disposal; distinct from expiry units.

transitions.name: SAP triggers Sonaflozin order
transitions.description: From external SAP position, commits a Sonaflozin purchase and its approximate SAP-priced EUR amount; cash timing not modelled.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.SapReorderSignal[0].units < parameters.sonaflozin_reorder_point;

transitions.name: Supplier dispatches shipment
transitions.description: Draft step from purchase order to transit; dispatch timing and supplier-outage rules have not been established.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const lot = input.SonaflozinOrdered[0];
return { SonaflozinInTransit: [{ units: lot.units, remaining_weeks: lot.remaining_weeks }] };

transitions.name: Shipment arrives into quarantine
transitions.description: Moves a received shipment into quarantine and counts its units once as a new Site 1000 receipt; time in transit remains part of shelf life.

transitions.name: Quality releases Sonaflozin
transitions.description: Moves a quarantined Sonaflozin lot into usable stock retaining remaining shelf life; an expired lot cannot be released.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.SonaflozinQuarantine[0].remaining_weeks > 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const lot = input.SonaflozinQuarantine[0];
return { SonaflozinReleased: [{ units: lot.units, remaining_weeks: lot.remaining_weeks }] };

transitions.name: Produce Sonic Flow order
transitions.description: Provisional atomic production using one unexpired Sonaflozin lot and available Flowbind; multi-lot allocation and production duration remain unresolved.

transitions.name: Ship customer order on time
transitions.description: Provisional on-time one-lot fulfillment; a customer order not yet past due and sufficient unexpired finished stock are required.

transitions.name: Mark finished stock past example life
transitions.description: Provisional boundary at about 28 weeks from production; tracks units no longer usable rather than asserting physical scrap.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.SonicFlowBatchProduced[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.age_weeks >= parameters.example_finished_life_weeks;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonicFlowExpired: [{ units: input.SonicFlowBatchProduced[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Order emergency Flowbind on low stock
transitions.description: Below-500 external stock reading orders 250 German Flowbind units and records approximate purchase cost plus estimated one-time switch cost.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.FlowbindStockReading[0].units < parameters.flowbind_emergency_point;

transitions.name: Order emergency Flowbind during Indian outage
transitions.description: Indian supplier outage triggers German emergency order and records approximate purchase cost plus team-estimated switch cost.

transitions.name: Receive German emergency Flowbind
transitions.description: On external receipt an unexpired German Flowbind top-up enters quarantine, not usable stock, while its units count once as site receipts.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.GermanFlowbindTopUpOrdered[0].remaining_weeks > 0;

transitions.name: Remove expired usable Sonaflozin
transitions.description: Remove a released lot at zero remaining weeks; unit write-down tally, not monetary value.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.SonaflozinReleased[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonaflozinExpiredUnits: [{ units: input.SonaflozinReleased[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Remove expired quarantined Sonaflozin
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.SonaflozinQuarantine[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonaflozinExpiredUnits: [{ units: input.SonaflozinQuarantine[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Record Sonaflozin loss before receipt
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.SonaflozinInTransit[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonaflozinPreReceiptLossUnits: [{ units: input.SonaflozinInTransit[0].units }] };
transitions.description: Shipment passes remaining-life boundary in transit, outside site-held expiry fraction; treatment as quality rejection and liability remain tentative.

transitions.name: Record Sonaflozin loss before dispatch
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.SonaflozinOrdered[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonaflozinPreReceiptLossUnits: [{ units: input.SonaflozinOrdered[0].units }] };
transitions.description: A lot lost before Site receipt is excluded from Site 1000's expired-stock fraction; rejection classification and cost liability unverified.

transitions.name: Remove expired usable Flowbind
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.FlowbindAvailable[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindExpiredUnits: [{ units: input.FlowbindAvailable[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Record German Flowbind loss before receipt
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.GermanFlowbindTopUpOrdered[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindPreReceiptLossUnits: [{ units: input.GermanFlowbindTopUpOrdered[0].units }] };
transitions.description: German emergency lot expires before Site receipt; excluded from Site 1000 expired-stock percentage, cost liability unresolved.

transitions.name: Ship contract customer order late
transitions.description: When contract order is past due, fulfills from one unexpired finished lot; lateness payment awaits cost input.

transitions.name: Spot customer cancels waiting order
transitions.description: Externally supplied cancellation consumes one waiting spot order and counts its requested units as lost sale; cancellations are not generated probabilistically.
transitions.lambdaCode: return !input.CustomerOrdersWaiting[0].is_contract;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SpotOrdersCancelled: [{ units: input.CustomerOrdersWaiting[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Order regular Indian Flowbind
transitions.description: External Flowbind inventory-position reading below 1,500 produces order toward 5,000 in 2,500-unit increments; new-lot life is agent placeholder and cost approximates SAP price.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.FlowbindSapPositionReading[0].units < parameters.flowbind_reorder_point;

transitions.name: Receive regular Indian Flowbind
transitions.description: On external receipt an unexpired Indian Flowbind lot enters quarantine, not usable stock, while its units count once as site receipts.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.IndianFlowbindOnOrder[0].remaining_weeks > 0;

transitions.name: Record Indian Flowbind loss before receipt
transitions.description: An Indian lot passing remaining life before Site receipt is tallied outside the Site 1000 expiry percentage; financial liability unresolved.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.IndianFlowbindOnOrder[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindPreReceiptLossUnits: [{ units: input.IndianFlowbindOnOrder[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Quality releases Flowbind
transitions.description: An external quality-release notice moves one unexpired quarantined Flowbind lot to usable stock, regardless of Indian or German source.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.FlowbindQuarantine[0].remaining_weeks > 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const lot = input.FlowbindQuarantine[0];
return { FlowbindAvailable: [{ units: lot.units, remaining_weeks: lot.remaining_weeks }] };

transitions.name: Remove expired quarantined Flowbind
transitions.description: After Site receipt but before quality release, expired Indian or German Flowbind is removed and counted in Site expiry units.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const lot = input.FlowbindQuarantine[0];
return lot.units > 0 && lot.remaining_weeks <= 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindExpiredUnits: [{ units: input.FlowbindQuarantine[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Quality rejects Sonaflozin lot
transitions.description: On external failed-inspection notice, an unexpired quarantined lot is removed and its units tallied for disposal; cost amount unknown.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.SonaflozinQuarantine[0].remaining_weeks > 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { SonaflozinRejectedUnits: [{ units: input.SonaflozinQuarantine[0].units }] };

transitions.name: Quality rejects Flowbind lot
transitions.description: On external failed-inspection notice, a quarantined Indian or German Flowbind lot is removed for disposal, separate from expiry; cost unknown.
transitions.lambdaCode: return input.FlowbindQuarantine[0].remaining_weeks > 0;
transitions.transitionKernelCode: return { FlowbindRejectedUnits: [{ units: input.FlowbindQuarantine[0].units }] };

types.name: Material quantity
types.description: A quantity in whole units for demand, SAP snapshots, customer shipments or cumulative expired-material counts; age-bearing material stock uses separate lot types.

types.name: Finished Sonic Flow lot
types.description: Finished batch inventory with quantity and age since production in weeks; age origin and cutoff are modelling assumptions awaiting confirmation.

types.name: Ingredient lot with remaining life
types.description: Lot quantities carry remaining usable weeks from supplier onward; current lots and future lots need separate remaining-life evidence.

types.name: Customer order with due time
types.description: One customer order: requested units, weeks remaining until due time, and whether it is a contract rather than spot customer.

types.name: Cost event in EUR
types.description: One modelled event with an EUR amount; order commitment timing is a modelling convention, not observed cash flow.

parameters.name: Unknown new Sonaflozin supplier remaining life (weeks; placeholder)
Unknown new German Flowbind lot life (weeks; agent placeholder)
Unknown new Indian Flowbind lot life (weeks; agent placeholder)

metrics.name: Waiting production orders
metrics.description: Number of production orders still awaiting completion at each observation, not an on-time service-level measure.

metrics.name: Unshipped Sonic Flow units
metrics.description: Current units in finished lots that have not shipped or crossed the model's approximate age cutoff.

metrics.name: Finished units past example life
metrics.description: Accumulated finished units moved out of saleable stock at the model's approximate shelf-life cutoff; not actual scrap records.

metrics.name: Site-received Sonaflozin expired units
metrics.description: Units expired only after Site 1000 receipt, including quarantine; excludes separate pre-receipt losses and is not monetary write-down.

metrics.name: Site-received Flowbind expired units
metrics.description: Flowbind units expiring after Site 1000 receipt from current stock, Indian regular or German emergency supply; excludes pre-receipt losses. Current-stock 156 weeks is team's assumption.

metrics.name: Customer orders shipped on time
metrics.description: Cumulative count of orders shipped no later than due; candidate numerator only, not yet Elena's formal fill-rate definition.

metrics.name: Candidate customer-order misses
metrics.description: Late contract shipments, cancelled spot orders and still-waiting orders past due; provisional order-count interpretation, not the agreed 95% measure.

metrics.name: Modelled supplier purchase commitments (EUR)
metrics.description: Approximate SAP-priced commitments for modelled Chinese Sonaflozin, Indian regular Flowbind and German emergency Flowbind orders; excludes other cost classes.

metrics.name: Estimated German switch costs (EUR)
metrics.description: Accumulated team-estimated EUR 5,000 per emergency German Flowbind order in this model; not measured costs.

metrics.name: Quality-rejected raw-material units
metrics.description: Cumulative units rejected by quality after Site receipt, both materials; not expiry, not a rejection probability or disposal EUR.
metrics.code: return state.places.SonaflozinRejectedUnits.tokens.reduce((sum, x) => sum + x.units, 0) + state.places.FlowbindRejectedUnits.tokens.reduce((sum, x) => sum + x.units, 0);

scenarios.name: Illustrative one-batch walkthrough (agent defaults)
scenarios.description: Agent-chosen smoke-test starting state, NOT a 104-week purchasing policy comparison. Guess: 2,500 units each of released Sonaflozin and Flowbind, Sonaflozin 100 weeks left (within the reported 88–156 current-lot range), Flowbind 156 weeks left (team's current-stock assumption), one 700-unit production order and one 700-unit contract customer order due in one week. No new supplies or disruptions are scheduled.
